correctness.rationale: Explicit disjoint four-sector parameterization of each integer diamond proves exact cardinality and supplies a bijective phase increment by one modulo \(4r+1\). Strict real floor inequalities identify \(F_\lambda\) with \(G\) on protected shells. At \(\lambda=1/q\), exact phase arcs in \(C_{q+1}\) and \(C_q\) exhaust all states before first return and avoid any unaccounted integer floor activation. This gives exact \(8q-2\) minimal period, \(4q+1\) inner-shell states and \(4q-3\) outer-shell states for all \(q\ge2\). A standalone checker using actual source code reproduces phase and orbit calculations up to stated bounds; the infinite argument does not rely on enumeration.

residual_risks: Older round-off rotation literature from the 1990s onward, not all available in searchable full text, may contain an unnoticed exact small-shell calculation.

value.rationale: The parameter 1/q is forced, not artificially selected: it is precisely the first possible positive integer floor output on the full \(q\)-th central shell. The result yields a natural complete protected central graph, exact sizes, a sharp stability radius and a nontrivial uniform first-resonance period merger into the next shell in a long-standing difficult discretized-rotation system. It is more substantive than existence of cycles, a small numerical table, or a sign/normalization exercise.
